items.title: Add Quantum gate policy model and transition decisions
items.context: Map existing evaluateQuantumClaim output into read-only decisions: advance, repair, degrade, escalate, or stop. The policy must preserve all no-overclaim boundary booleans and must not mutate lifecycle state.
items.userSees: A local Quantum gate check returns deterministic transition guidance for admissible, weak, stale, missing, mismatched, and overclaiming evidence.

happy.desc: Complete bound Q5 evidence produces an advance decision with local claim-admissibility only.

edge.desc: Weak but scoped evidence can produce a degrade decision rather than a false hard pass.

adversarial.desc: Production, Authority, hardware, theory, stale, missing, or mismatched evidence never produces advance.

items.title: Expose a read-only quantum_claim_check CLI command
items.context: Add command catalog, handler wiring, registry entry, command policy, and phase availability for a read-only local diagnostic command. The command must write no gate evidence and must never claim DONE, production, or Authority.
items.userSees: Hosts can run quantum_claim_check to inspect local quantum claim admissibility and gate-policy guidance without changing story lifecycle state.

happy.desc: quantum_claim_check renders a passing JSON/text result for complete demo evidence.

edge.desc: quantum_claim_check supports a degraded/weak demo case and reports degrade without lifecycle mutation.

adversarial.desc: quantum_claim_check rejects overclaiming demo cases and reports boundary booleans with productionDone and authorityDone false.

items.title: Extend focused Quantum smoke coverage for M3
items.context: Extend the existing quantum smoke to cover pure policy helpers and the CLI command path. Keep coverage deterministic and local.
items.userSees: The focused smoke transcript includes Quantum M3 gate policy pass/degrade/stop cases and the quantum_claim_check command surface.

happy.desc: Focused smoke prints a Quantum M3 gate policy success line.

edge.desc: Smoke exercises weak/degraded evidence and missing/stale evidence categories.

adversarial.desc: Smoke proves no M4/M5 or external readiness claim is emitted by the M3 command.

items.title: Update Quantum documentation runtime status to M0-M3
items.context: Update the Quantum plan and adapter-pack framework docs so the delivered runtime status says M0-M3 implemented and M4-M5 pending, while preserving the no-theory/no-hardware/no-production/no-Authority boundary.
items.userSees: The docs accurately state that M3 adds local read-only gate policy guidance and that benchmark/reporting remain pending.
excludes: Do not claim full lifecycle transition integration

happy.desc: Docs say M0-M3 implemented and M4-M5 pending.

edge.desc: Docs distinguish local gate-policy guidance from global Story machine mutation.

adversarial.desc: Docs retain no quantum theory, hardware, production, Authority, benchmark, or report completion claim.
